**What problem does this solve?**

A clear description of what you're trying to do that GitGrounded doesn't
support today.

**Proposed solution**

What you'd like to happen — a new flag, a new mode, a change to existing
behavior, etc.

**Which mode does this affect?**

- [ ] Git mode
- [ ] Endpoint mode
- [ ] Both / neither (e.g. docs, CI, packaging)

**Alternatives considered**

Any workarounds you're currently using instead.

**Additional context**

Anything else worth knowing.
